args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Plans (June 10th - June 20th, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, water-resistant)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, backpack)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Camera (for capturing memories)
- Travel documents (passport, ID, tickets)
- Sunglasses and hat
- Beach towel
- Flip-flops
- Light jacket (for air conditioning)
- Toiletries (shampoo, conditioner, toothbrush, etc.)
- First aid kit
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks
- Power bank
- Phone charger
- Cash and credit cards
